title: How Marc Lou built 23 websites and earned $562,943 solo
summary: Marc Lou walks through every product he built after being fired in 2021, with traffic and revenue for each. Results were very uneven: most earned little or nothing, and ShipFast alone made about $380k. The lessons are to ship constantly, launch in public, use funny videos for distribution, cross-promote your products, reuse code, and sell projects that stall.

principles.text: Build many small products; results are very uneven, and a few winners pay for all the failures.
principles.quote: you'll see that it's very uneven some never made money some made well over five figures

principles.text: Use funny videos as a launch booster; they bring the first visitors and Product Hunt badges.
principles.quote: For any new product I launch I created one funish video that I would post on social media

principles.text: Market by building: ship small tools that funnel visitors to your main product.
principles.quote: I try to find some clever way to do marketing by creating things

principles.text: Prefer one-time payments over subscriptions when you dislike subscriptions as a customer.
principles.quote: I'm a big fan of no subscription as a customer I don't like subscriptions so I would like to avoid subscriptions if I can

principles.text: Turn repeated work into a product: your own boilerplate became ShipFast.
principles.quote: I was doing the same thing over and over like set up a landing page

principles.text: Sell projects that stall or can't compete; even small products can find a buyer.
principles.quote: I decided to sell the product so I listed it on acquire and within a few weeks the deal was done and made $35,000 in sale
